steps.text: Beat 1: the sentence
LAW has locked Wemmbu in its prison for banning more than 1,000 players.

steps.speaker: LettuceK
steps.text: [placeholder] When I am king, Wemmbu will be executed.
If LettuceK wins the election, Wemmbu will be executed.
Beat 2: the prison and its rules. Guards walk their rounds and do not attack yet.
Elder guardians give Mining Fatigue. Guards listen to what prisoners say. Rooms have airlocks, and prisoners are searched after work.
Beat 3: daily jobs. Not built yet: the job system.
Do today's prison job: mine with wooden tools, farm, chop trees or train. (/story next to skip)
Beat 4: the clue
Wemmbu remembers that Spoke once reached his solitary cell. There might be a way in, and a way out.
Beat 5: talking in secret. Not built yet: guard hearing range.
Plan with the other prisoners during work or training, away from the guards. (/story next to skip)
Beat 6: gathering. Not built yet: inspections.
Note useful items and find the guards' ender chests. Don't take anything before an inspection. (/story next to skip)
Beat 7: the plan
The plan: wear down the Curse of Binding armour by taking damage, then drink invisibility and slip away.
Beat 8: the first escape fails (scripted)
Dig a tunnel out of the prison. (/story next to skip)
The armour isn't breaking fast enough, and the food is running out.

steps.speaker: LettuceK
steps.text: [placeholder] Take them to solitary. Guard them day and night.
You are in solitary confinement. (/story next to continue)
Beat 9: Spoke's offer

steps.speaker: SpokeIsHere
steps.text: [placeholder] I can get you out. But then you work with me.

steps.speaker: Wemmbu
steps.text: [placeholder] Fine. Get me out.
Beat 10: the breakout. Check which kit Wemmbu really has here.
Fight your way through the prison
Beat 11: run from the geared group outside. Not built yet: the chase.
A heavily geared LAW group is waiting outside. With Mining Fatigue and this gear, Wemmbu can't win that fight.
Run. Get away from the prison. (/story next to skip)
Beat 12: ending
Wemmbu heads for the Farlands to get his strength back. To beat LAW he'll need his elytra mace and orbital strikes.
